Camera stands just inside a side opening on a broad white marble landing, low oblique three-quarter view using a 50mm photographic visual language; look diagonally across the landing, not along a central bridge toward a distant palace. The bronze bell occupies the upper central part, its heavy circular lip and deep patinated metal curved surface unmistakable even within the central 26 percent vertical crop. A visible credible dark timber crossbeam and reinforced traditional suspension carry its weight above; ordered Chinese dougong joinery and a little deep red timber frame the edges, without stacks of roofs. Shallow broad marble steps enter from the lower right and curve gently toward an open lower landing, no people. Ordinary small balustrades and one distant plain lamp communicate huge scale. The bell is green-brown oxidized bronze with restrained cloud-and-thunder geometric relief and small rubbed warm-metal edges, no inscriptions. Clear late-morning cool daylight enters laterally from the left, grazing bronze texture and white mineral-veined marble. Outside the pavilion, thin near mist, volumetric blue-gray cloud valleys and luminous textured white cloud tops fade into a pale cyan horizon; distant space stays open, no additional palaces, sun, moon or other wonders. Quiet awe, physical substance, believable architecture and diffuse sky bounce preserve all shadows. Center mobile crop retains the bell lip high above and broad quiet pale floor below; the actual middle text area is a restful low-detail transition of soft clouds and cool marble, no sharp high-contrast lines crossing its center. Do not draw any text card or overlay. The stage is an informal place to practice a presentation, not a concert venue: no screens, lectern, equipment or audience. The upper center contains a legible descending curve of timber tiers and a softly lit planted edge; the central middle and lower part hold the quiet open stone floor, gently reflecting the indigo sky with a few restrained amber recessed step lights. A single slender broad-canopy tree rises from a planting pocket toward the upper center, soft dark leaves framing a patch of twilight blue sky, sparse ornamental grasses around the edge, distant low campus windows soft and unobtrusive.
